description: Defines the e_cid_measurement_initiation_procedure class for handling E-CID measurement initiation procedures in 3GPP TS 38.455, including methods for creating request/response PDUs, handling outcomes, and managing measurement processes.

classes.name: e_cid_measurement_initiation_procedure
classes.description: Handles the E-CID Measurement Initiation procedure, including request/response creation, measurement setup, and communication with CU-CP.

methods.name: e_cid_measurement_initiation_procedure
methods.description: Constructor initializing the procedure with necessary context and parameters.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Executes the procedure asynchronously within a coroutine context.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the procedure.

methods.name: setup_periodic_measurement
methods.description: Configures periodic measurement for a UE.

methods.name: get_measurement_result
methods.description: Retrieves measurement results for a UE.

methods.name: create_e_cid_measurement_initiation_failure
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 PDU for measurement initiation failure with specified cause.

methods.name: create_e_cid_measurement_initiation_response
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 PDU for measurement initiation response, indicating if on-demand.

methods.name: handle_procedure_outcome
methods.description: Logs and forwards the procedure outcome, including success or failure.

methods.name: send_ul_nrppa_pdu
methods.description: Sends the E-CID measurement outcome PDU to CU-CP.
